Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

7. Paeking — The round punches shall be given an antiruat treatment. They ahall be supplied In sete 
In suitable steel eases. The packing shall be in accordance with the best prevalent trade practice. 

•• Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller the procedure given In 
18 : 2500 ( Part I )-1963 ' Sampling inspection tables: Part I Inspection by attributea and by count of 
defects \ may be followed for sampling inspection. The sampling plans for various characteristics 
shall be according to S.1 and 8.2. 

t.1 For inspection of dimensions, single sampling plan with inspection level III and acceptable quellty 
tovel ( AQL ) of 2*6 percent [ see Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2600 ( Part I )«1 963 ] ahall be adopted. 

•.t For inspection of hardness and test, single sampling plan with Inspection kivel I end acceptable 
quality level (AQL) of 1*0 percent [see Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2600 (Part l)-1963] ahall be 
adopted. 

•• Marking — Round punches shall be marked with the nominal size, msnufacturer'e name, Initlaie 
or recognized trade-mark. The containers of the punches shall also k>e merited with the deecrlptlon 
of the contents. In case of small punches where it may not be possible to mark the punch itself, 
only the container shall be marked with the description of the contents. 

9.1 ISI Cerilftcailon Marking— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution^ 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standerd deals with round punches for cold punching of holee in sheet metal. This 
standard was originally Issued In 1963 and was revised in 1966 so as to include: (e) Dimensional 
requirement In metric system, and (b) Sampling plan and criteria for confonrnity. 

The present revision hes been taken up to bring the standard In line with the current manu- 
facturing practices and provision has been made that the punches of nominal sizes 2 and 3 mm may 
be manufactured from round aectlons ss well.
